_comment: Power-budget config for px4_bridge.py --power-sim / power_model.py. Every value is a PLACEHOLDER - replace with datasheet numbers. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Omitted keys keep their defaults; unknown keys are an error.

battery._comment: End-of-flight scenario: start at 30% and drain 5x faster so a ~2 min HIL flight covers the bottom of the discharge curve.

regulator._comment: Buck converter from the main bus to the Jetson carrier input.

jetson._comment: Set power_w from tegrastats on the real unit at your nvpmodel mode, plus peripherals. min_input_v comes from the carrier board datasheet.

faults._comment: Times are seconds after PX4 first arms. Overlapping events do not stack: the largest active drop applies at the regulator input.
